title: Three empty results
description: Three incident searches return the same empty tray; look inside each housing to see what the tray leaves out, then make the tool return it.
initialCaption: Three searches for payments incidents in the last hour returned the same empty tray.
interactionHint: Drag to look around · scroll to zoom · click a housing to open it
fallback: Three searches return identical empty lists, but only one read the whole hour; one stopped at its scan budget and one timed out before reaching existing incidents. Returning status, coverage and a cursor lets the caller tell these apart.
